description: A contiguous network of gently curving, contour‐parallel embankments and shallow channels forming irregular polygons approximately 80–120 m across. The raised rims are ≈0.5 m high and follow the natural slope lines, suggesting deliberate micro‐terracing or water‐diversion works.

An array of rectilinear depressions and narrow ridges, each roughly 30–50 m in length, arranged in parallel contour strips on a slight bench. In the NIR band these trenches appear darker (higher moisture retention), consistent with backfilled ditches or moisture‐harvesting furrows.

A semi‐circular embanked enclosure, approximately 100 m in diameter, with an inward‐opening gap to the north. Hillshade and curvature highlight a smooth berm ~0.4 m high; vegetation on its crest shows slight stress in the visual band, and enhanced moisture in NIR.
